text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said it lowered its rating on Pharmacyclics Inc stock to neutral from attractive after changing its expectations on the availability of its Lu-Tex breast cancer treatment product.

-- The drug-development company is expected to initiate a pivotal trial for Lu-Tex in treating recurrent breast cancer in the next three months, Vector said. However, the protocol for the test will be different and more cumbersome than originally anticipated, pushing back Vector's timelines for completion of the trial and regulatory approval.
-- Vector lowered its earnings estimate to a loss of $1.27 a share in fiscal 1999 from a profit of $0.08 and its earnings forecast for 2000 to $0.44 from $2.35.
-- Its shares were up 1/4 Wednesday at 23.
